method.name: isotonic_regression_pchip_lut
method.description: PAVA monotonic regression, PCHIP forward interpolation, and linear inverse lookup table

evaluation_policy.inverse_evaluation: piecewise-linear ADC-to-load LUT with endpoint clamping; not an exact inverse of PCHIP
evaluation_policy.plateau_policy: merge equal isotonic ADC knots at midpoint of corresponding load interval; no endpoint re-anchoring
evaluation_policy.saturation_policy: no assumed 3000 g cutoff; measured ADC saturation and plateaus remain visible

shared_endpoints_adc.aggregation: median across captures at each repeated load
